newsitem.title: USA: ADC gets $10 mln Cox supplier contract.
newsitem.headline: ADC gets $10 mln Cox supplier contract.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc's Broadband Communications Division said Tuesday that Cox Communications Inc chose ADC as its primary supplier for digital video transport equipment.
The deal is valued at more than $10 million over three years.

Cox will use ADC's DV6000 digital video transport equipment in some of its most populated U.S. areas where it provides cable television. Cox said it chose ADC because of its product's flexibility and the quality of the delivered video.
Cox is cable television operator serving more than 3.2 million customers.
ADC supplies transmission and networking systems to deliver voice, data and video service.
